values.note: Hillsborough County: $24 a night for up to 8 people with 1 RV/trailer or 2 tents; $18 for an adult 55 or older and $12 for a Hillsborough County resident 65 or older (registered in that person's name, present all nights). Park entrance $2 per vehicle; the spring swim area $2 per person.
